ux_intent: Validate that audiobook-player transport controls meet 48dp tap-target minimums, the seekbar displays current position and duration in legible text, cover art is labelled, and text on the dark player background is full-opacity — not semi-transparent.
figma_make_prompt:
Build an audiobook player screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Use a top app bar with a back arrow (left) and a three-dot menu (right, 48x48dp touch target). Title shows the current audiobook title (Body Small, 14sp, #FFFFFF) on the dark background.

Layout:
- Full-screen dark background #1E1E2E. Vertical stack, centred.
- Cover art: square image 240x240dp, centred, 24px below the top app bar. A text label beneath it (Caption, 12sp, #FFFFFF): "Cover art for [Title]".
- Below cover art: title (Title Medium, 22sp, #FFFFFF, weight 600) and author (Body Small, 14sp, #FFFFFF at 70 % opacity), both centred.
- Seekbar: full-width minus 32px horizontal padding. Touch-target height 48dp. Track 4dp thick — elapsed portion primary #6366F1, remaining portion #4B5563. Thumb 20dp diameter, #FFFFFF. Position label left (Body Small, 14sp, #FFFFFF): "2 min 15 s". Duration label right: "45 min 00 s".
- Transport controls row: centred, horizontal, evenly spaced. Five buttons, each 48x48dp touch target, icons #FFFFFF:
  - Rewind 30s (circular arrow + "30")
  - Previous chapter
  - Play / Pause (56x56dp touch target, primary colour #6366F1 filled circle, white icon)
  - Next chapter
  - Fast-forward 30s (circular arrow + "30")
- Below controls: playback speed chip ("1.0×", outlined, 48dp touch target) and bookmark toggle (heart icon, 48x48dp touch target), spaced 16px apart, centred.

States:
- Playing: Play icon swapped to Pause. Seekbar thumb advances.
- Paused: Pause icon swapped to Play. Seekbar thumb stationary.
- Buffering: Play/Pause icon replaced by a circular spinner (24dp). Seekbar stationary.
- Error: full-width banner below cover art on a #EF4444 background — "Playback error. Tap to retry." White text, 48dp height.
- Completed: seekbar at 100 %. Banner: "Chapter complete" with a "Next chapter" CTA button (primary filled).

Behavior:
- Tap Play/Pause → toggle playing and paused states.
- Tap Rewind 30s → seekbar jumps back 30 seconds, position label updates immediately.
- Drag seekbar thumb → position label updates in real time.
- Tap three-dot menu → bottom sheet: Download, Share, Speed options.

Style:
- Dark surface. Background #1E1E2E. All text #FFFFFF full opacity (never semi-transparent for body or label text). Primary #6366F1. Auto layout, responsive.
- All transport-control touch targets ≥ 48x48dp. Play/Pause ≥ 56x56dp.

First step: paused state with all five transport controls visible at correct sizes, seekbar with position and duration labels, and cover art with its text label.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the audiobook player is in the playing state
When the user views the transport controls
Then all five buttons are visible, each with a touch target ≥ 48x48dp, and the Play icon has changed to Pause

Given the seekbar is displayed
When the user views the current position
Then position is shown as human-readable text (e.g., "2 min 15 s") left of the seekbar and total duration is shown right

Given the player encounters a playback error
When the error state is rendered
Then a full-width error banner with a retry action is shown and transport controls are visually disabled

Given the cover art is displayed
When the user views it
Then a text label beneath it identifies the currently playing title
manual_validation_checklist: Measure all five transport-control touch targets: each ≥ 48x48dp; Play/Pause ≥ 56x56dp
Verify all text on the dark background is full-opacity #FFFFFF — no semi-transparent colours anywhere
Check seekbar position and duration labels: ≥ 14sp, #FFFFFF, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 against #1E1E2E
Confirm cover-art label is present, ≥ 12sp, #FFFFFF, and does not overlap the cover image
Verify error banner spans full content width and the retry CTA is a distinct tappable element ≥ 48dp
Check buffering spinner replaces Play/Pause icon with no layout shift
